datasets.title: Somalia Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.3 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 71% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 7% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and validated against AI-mapped estimates to assess coverage completeness (~71% of total buildings). Data were compiled into multiple geospatial formats (shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML) with metadata tracking indicating average data age of 4 years and recent updates within 6 months.
